review.status: Starter list: maintainer and native-speaker review required before deployment.
review.scope: Group-directed racial, ethnic and antisemitic slurs only; not a general profanity list or a complete list of hate speech.
review.matching: Latin-script entries use whole-word matching. Explicit plural forms are separate entries. Only the specific Japanese and Korean entries opt into substring matching for unspaced text and attached particles.
review.ambiguity: Common words, nationality names and context-dependent terms are intentionally omitted. The French youpin/youpins forms are omitted because spacing normalization would also match ordinary English 'you pin'/'you pins'. Blocking is lexical and cannot distinguish quotation, reclamation or historical discussion.
review.privacy: Server-only policy data. Do not copy this file into client packages or language catalogs.

terms.note: Reclaimed use is also blocked; lexical filtering has no speaker context.
Ambiguous words such as animal names and cultural identity terms are omitted.
Specific multi-character slur; the shorter sound expression is not listed.
